retrievalProfile.description: A centered portrait of a female artist inside a vintage car with tan leather interiors and top-aligned wide sans-serif text.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a blonde woman leaning over the front passenger seat of a vintage car, featuring warm earth tones, natural sunlight, and bold, wide-set white typography at the top center.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject framed by the car's interior pillars and headrests
Warm tan leather tones contrasting with blue denim and cool exterior light
Text centered horizontally in the upper third of the frame
Soft focus on the background landscape visible through windows
coreInvariants: Vintage tan leather car interior with perforated headliner
Subject wearing a shimmering rhinestone-embellished mesh top

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, leaning forward from the back seat over a brown leather headrest.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large brown leather headrest in the foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold white text at the top, move down to the subject's face, and follow the curve of the arm and headrest.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper corners and the bright outdoor scenery visible through the car windows.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm tan and brown (car interior and skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-key lighting with warm, saturated browns and desaturated, bright backgrounds.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Weight and scale contrast within the same extended sans-serif family.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the square, wide geometric structure of the display text.
Provides the necessary horizontal stretch and modern feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-quality photograph of a blonde woman in a rhinestone-studded tan mesh top, leaning over the brown leather headrest of a vintage car's front seat. The interior should be tan/brown leather with a perforated ceiling. Natural sunlight should come from the side windows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered, white, extra-wide sans-serif text at the top. The first line should be bold and large; the second line should be smaller with wider letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the text centered and top-aligned?
Is the car interior tan leather?
Is the typography an extended sans-serif?
Is the subject wearing a rhinestone mesh top?

mustRedesign: Original brand markings on the car

avoid: Mismatched lighting between subject and car

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is perfectly horizontal and centered.
Ensure the rhinestone texture on the clothing is visible and detailed.
Verify the car interior looks like a vintage model from the 70s or 80s.
Confirm the color palette remains dominated by warm browns and white.
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Car Interior + Centered Extended Sans-Serif + Warm Earth Tones
